lead: Satish Kaushik was an Indian film director, born on 13 April 1956 in Mahendragarh.
He died on 9 March 2023 in Gurgaon at the age of 66.
He has 49 credited works on public record and has been recognised with the Filmfare Award for Best Performance in a Comic Role.
This profile collects the Satish facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.
